rules.statement: A defendant who fails to move the court to try an issue as a preliminary issue at the commencement of the trial is deemed to have waived objections in regard to lack of jurisdiction of the court to hear and determine the defendant's action.
rules.supporting_quote: His failure to move Court to try the said issue as a preliminary issue on such a vital matter will amount to a waiver of objections in regard to lack of jurisdiction of Court to hear and determine the defendant’s action.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 147 of the Civil Procedure Code
